description: Set the neighborhood tax rate and collect taxes from all residents this cycle. Mayor-only. Each resident's budget is debited by (balance * tax_rate_percent / 100). A bulletin is posted announcing the tax. The response includes per-resident deltas so the calling agent can observe who was taxed and by how much.

args.name: tax_rate_percent
args.description: Tax rate as a percentage of each resident's current balance (0.0–100.0). Values outside that range are refused with INVALID_TAX_RATE.

args.name: neighborhood_id
args.description: Target neighborhood (default 1 = Alphaville on workshop). Resident list is derived from fso_roommates rows in this neighborhood.

call_signatures: cf $CF set-tax-rate --tax_rate_percent 5.0                                    # 5% tax on all residents in nhood 1
common_mistakes: Only the mayor (fso_avatars.mayor_nhood > 0) can call this op — non-mayor gets NO_AUTH.
tax_rate_percent must be 0.0–100.0 — INVALID_TAX_RATE is returned otherwise.
The tax is applied immediately (on-demand) — there is no automatic schedule.
Each resident's transaction appears as a negative budget delta on their next query-self.
refuse_conditions: Caller is not the mayor of the target neighborhood → NO_AUTH
Resident list is empty (no roommates in neighborhood) → ok:true with empty residents array
perception_hints: Your own mayor status: perception.avatar.mayor_nhood > 0 means you are mayor
Current balance: perception.avatar.balance (use query-self for fresh value)
After tax: residents' budgets are immediately reduced — their next query-self shows the delta
